newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $27 bln of cash bills April 1.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $27 bln of cash bills April 1.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury said on Tuesday that it will auction $10 billion of 14-day cash management bills and $17 billion of 19-day cash bills on April 1.
The bills will be issued April 3. The 14-day bills mature on April 17 and the 19-day bills mature on April 22.
Minimum bids will be in amounts of $10,000.
Noncompetitive tenders on both maturities will be accepted in full up to $1 million at the average discount rate of accepted competitive bids, which must be received by 1300 EST (1800 GMT).
The CUSIP number for the 14-day bills will be 9127944F8 and for the 19-day bills will be 9127946Y5.
